official.status_note: PSC states: 'Applications for PSC Scholarships for 2027 are now open and will close on 15 March 2027.'
official.tuition_coverage_note: Tuition fees and other approved charges. For overseas degrees, return airfare will be provided. For mid-term candidates, tuition and other compulsory fees incurred before the award will be back paid.
benefits: Tuition fees and other approved charges
Full salary including bonuses for those on the Uniformed Service track
Sponsorship of PSC development programmes and approved student exchange or summer programmes
PSC also facilitates internship opportunities for scholarship holders
Sponsorship of master's degree (if requirements are met)
Back payment of tuition and other compulsory fees incurred before the award, for mid-term candidates
eligibility: Demonstrate Strong Leadership Qualities and Potential
Present themselves as well-rounded individuals, possessing good academic and non-academic records
GCE A-levels; or International Baccalaureate; or NUS High School Diploma; or Polytechnic Diploma with merit; or other high school diploma or equivalent
Mid-term applicants additionally need at least one semester of university results, and must apply before the final year of undergraduate studies
For professional schemes with a tied agency, be undertaking an undergraduate degree in an area relevant to the tied agency
requirements: Submit an online application complete with the necessary supporting documents, an essay, and a video interview
A valid Singpass account is required to access and submit the scholarship application form
The scholarship application portal is not supported on mobile devices and tablets; use a laptop or desktop computer
Applicants may apply prior to receiving final examination results; a provisional offer may be made subject to confirmation on release of final results
documents: Secondary 4 / Year 4 Year End School Academic Reports (including results and teachers' comments)
Secondary 4 / Year 4 Co-curricular Activities (CCA) and Community Involvement Programme (CIP) Records

Certificates of Academic Qualification Obtained (e.g. GCE O-level, GCE A-level, International Baccalaureate Diploma, NUS High School Diploma, Polytechnic Diploma, other high school diploma or equivalent)

Mid-term applicants additionally: University Academic Transcripts, University CCA Records, Employment Testimonials (if applicable), NS Certificate of Service and Testimonial (if applicable), Public Service Internship Testimonials (if applicable)
selection_criteria: PSC frames its holders as a diverse group of outstanding young talents who are all-rounded and committed to serving Singapore and Singaporeans, excelling in both academic and non-academic pursuits, possessing sound character and exemplifying the ethos of the Public Service
Performance in the psychometric assessments, game-based assessments and psychological interview is taken into consideration when deciding on further shortlisting
Only candidates who complete all assessments will undergo a panel interview with the Public Service Commission Scholarships Selection Board (PSSB)
coverage: Tuition fees and other approved charges
Full salary including bonuses on the Uniformed Service track
Development programmes: Preparatory Course, PSC Scholarship Holders' Mid-Course Programme, Gap Year Programme, Public Service Leadership Programme
Approved student exchange or summer programmes and facilitated internship opportunities
Sponsorship of master's degree (if requirements are met)
Back payment of tuition and compulsory fees for mid-term candidates
application_method: Log in to the PSC Gateway Portal via Singpass
Complete the online application form (Personal & Family Details, Education History, Achievements, Career and Course Preferences, University Applications, Other Details, Declaration)
Submit the required essay alongside the application form
Upload and submit all supporting documents; the application is only complete when form, essay and documents are all submitted
Receive the video interview link within 7 days of successful submission and complete the video interview
If shortlisted, attend psychometric assessments, game-based assessments and a psychological interview, then a panel interview with the PSSB
official.application_route: Apply online through the PSC Gateway Portal with Singpass before 15 March 2027, completing form, essay, document uploads and a video interview.
official.international_eligibility: No. The published criterion is that applicants must be Singapore Citizens.
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Professional Service schemes carry a tied agency (Engineering, Foreign Service, Judicial Service/Legal Service, Medicine or Dentistry, Public Finance, Teaching Service); for those schemes the undergraduate degree must be relevant to the tied agency.
official.duration: Maximum undergraduate study duration varies by country of study: 3 years in the UK, 4 years in the US, 2 years in other countries, with additional year(s) granted for a Master's; no maximum is stated for undergraduate study in Singapore.
official.description: PSC describes the PSC Scholarship as the premier government scholarship awarded based on merit, offering varied career pathways in the Singapore Public Service across the Public Administration, Professional Service and Uniformed Service tracks.
official.program_type: Government undergraduate scholarship for the Singapore Public Service, three career tracks

not_confirmed: maximum study duration for undergraduate study in Singapore
verification.notes: Checked the PSC undergraduate scholarship page and the PSC apply page on psc.gov.sg; PSC publishes the components of the award (tuition and approved charges, return airfare, allowances, development programmes, master's sponsorship) but no monetary figure, so no amount is recorded. Deadline and study/bond duration tables read directly from the official page.

applicant_utility.summary: This is the flagship route into the Singapore Public Service for Citizen school leavers and mid-term undergraduates, and the application is deliberately multi-stage: a Singpass-based form, an essay, a document upload and an on-camera video interview all have to be finished before PSC treats the file as complete. There is no cash stipend figure published, so budget against the named components rather than a headline number. Deadline is firm at 15 March 2027 for the 2027 cycle.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Singapore Citizen school leavers with a leadership-heavy, all-round record who are drawn to policy work or to a tied professional service.
application_readiness_checklist: Sort out Singpass two-factor access on a desktop before the cycle opens, because the portal will not run on phones or tablets.
Scan your Secondary 4 / Year 4 year-end reports, CCA and CIP records and qualification certificates into one folder so the upload step is not a scramble.
Decide which of the three tracks you are aiming at: Public Administration, Professional Service with a tied agency, or Uniformed Service.
Treat the essay as its own deliverable rather than a form field, and draft it before the window opens.
Keep a free hour within seven days of submitting, because the video interview link arrives on PSC's timeline, not yours.
common_rejection_risks: Submitting the form but leaving the essay or one document set unsubmitted, since PSC only counts an application as complete when all three parts are in.
Applying as a mid-termer past the penultimate year, or without at least one semester of university results.
Choosing a Professional Service scheme whose tied agency does not match the degree you are reading.
Missing a scheduled assessment or interview without valid reason.
Relying on a provisional offer made before final results without confirming those results.
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: PSC publishes no allowance amounts, so the size of the maintenance allowance cannot be gauged from the page; any course, activity or study period not approved by PSC is self-funded.
document_audit: The document list splits into a universal set and a mid-term-only set, so mid-term applicants need university transcripts, university CCA records, and NS or internship testimonials on top of the school records.
Preliminary examination results are explicitly not required, so do not upload them in place of the final qualification certificates.
Employment testimonials are 'if applicable', which matters for graduates from the private sector.
National Servicemen need the NS Certificate of Service and Testimonial, which takes time to obtain.
alerts: The 2027 window closes 15 March 2027 and the video interview link only arrives after a successful submission, so a late application compresses every later stage.
Assessments and interviews run from August through to June of the following year, so a 2027 offer may not resolve until mid-2027.
Mid-term applicants get tuition back-paid but allowances only start from the point of award, so early living costs are uncovered.
Bond length differs by country of study: 6 years for English-speaking countries, 5 for non-English-speaking, 4 for Singapore.
The Uniformed Service track pays full salary including bonuses, which changes the value calculation substantially compared with the other tracks.
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Singpass login, then form plus essay plus uploads, then a video interview link within 7 days, then assessments and a panel interview, with an outcome by June.
